name: Blitz Super Wheel

features.name: Super Wheel
features.description: Randomly awards one of seven features on any spin.

features.name: Free spins
features.description: 5–8 spins from the wheel or three scatters.

review:
Almost every spin could trigger something. The Super Wheel can award 5–10 random wilds, 5–8 Supercharged Wilds that double all wins, stacked wild reels, 8–12 mystery symbols, In-Sync Reels, or a Pot Prize from five jackpots worth up to 10,000x.

It can also hand out 5–8 free spins, which three scatters trigger too. Busy and full of variety. Up to 10,000x, 96.52% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
